**Sources**

- [Bodhi 2003] Bhikkhu Bodhi, Connected Discourses of the Buddha: A New Translation of the Samyutta Nikaya (2003) — Documented the collection's structure within Nidānavagga, its English translation, Kassapa's ascetic preeminence, and sutta themes.
- [Nyanaponika et al. 2003] Nyanaponika Thera, Hellmuth Hecker, Bhikkhu Bodhi, Great Disciples of the Buddha (2003) — Provided details on Kassapa's ordination, exchange of robes, arahantship (SN 16.11), and the Buddha's invitation to teach (SN 16.6).
- [Flores 2008] Ralph Flores, Buddhist Scriptures as Literature (2008) — Summarized the exchange in SN 16.13 regarding the decline of beings and the proliferation of rules.
